args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST

ESSENTIALS:
- Passport/ID
- Driver's license
- Travel insurance documents
- Cash and credit cards
- Sunglasses and sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Hat or cap
- Beach towel
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Flip flops or sandals
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Light jacket or cardigan (for air-conditioned spaces)

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach umbrella or canopy
- Inflatable floaties
- Water shoes (for rocky areas)
- Beach umbrella
- Beach games (frisbee, volleyball)

CLOTHING:
- T-shirts and tank tops
- Shorts and light pants
- Dresses for dinner
- Underwear and socks
- Pajamas
- Rain jacket or poncho (Hawaii can be rainy)
- Light layers for temperature changes

MEDICAL & PERSONAL:
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Hand sanitizer
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Deodorant
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Hairbrush/comb
- Contact lens supplies
- Feminine hygiene products

ELECTRONICS:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power bank
- Headphones
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Portable speaker

DOCUMENTS:
- Hotel reservations
- Car rental confirmation
- Activity bookings
- Emergency contacts
- Medical information

HAWAII-SPECIFIC:
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Water bottle
- Reusable shopping bags
- Dry bag for water activities
- Hawaii state park pass (if needed)
- Lei for arrival

TIPS:
- Pack light layers for air conditioning
- Bring waterproof bags for beach items
- Consider bringing a small cooler for snacks
- Pack items in clear bags for airport security
- Keep valuables in a secure place
- Stay hydrated!
